papers.title: Readout adaptation in simulated arm reaching: learned compensation and performance after updates stop
papers.translated_title: 模拟手臂伸展中的读出适应：学习到的补偿及更新停止后的表现
papers.author: Kobayashi, J.
papers.summary: When an arm learns to compensate for a force that deflects its movement, removing the force can produce an opposite deviation, or after-effect. We evaluate what the controller retains by measuring the after-effect, the learned torque correction, and tracking performance after weight updates stop. We use a simulated torque-driven planar two-link arm reaching in eight directions under velocity-dependent sideways forces. Only an external linear torque readout adapts online; the parameters generating its features stay fixed. Features come from three configurations of closed-form continuous-time (CfC) networks, an echo-state network, or a radial-basis-function layer. All three CfC configurations, including neural circuit policy wiring, are trained for 400 epochs. These five feature-based variants use least-mean-squares (LMS) learning; a sixth uses recursive least squares (RLS) on the dense-backbone CfC readout. Learning rates are selected on three model initializations and evaluated on ten separate initializations under three force fields. All six variants improve tracking relative to their fixed-readout baselines and pass our after-effect criterion in every evaluation run. Diagnostics on the same ten evaluation initializations in the main field (60 conditions) quantify differences behind this shared decision: the median normalized squared residual between the learned output change and ideal compensation ranges from 0.0097 to 0.383 across implementations on common prescribed inputs. With updates stopped and feedback control active, all final readouts retain useful compensation, reducing tracking error by 40-97% relative to their pre-adaptation versions. Compared with the final adaptive cycle, the five LMS variants have median fixed-readout error ratios of 2.28-5.87, while RLS remains nearly unchanged. These measurements distinguish the performance achieved during adaptation from that retained in the final weights. They provide a concrete evaluation procedure for readout adaptation: measure the learned output correction and test the final controller with updates off, alongside behavioral after-effects. The comparison characterizes complete implementations in this task; differences in preparation and hyperparameters limit attribution to feature representations or update rules alone.
papers.translated_summary: 当手臂学会补偿一个使其运动偏转的力时，移除该力会产生相反的偏差，即后效应。我们通过测量后效应、学习到的力矩校正以及权重更新停止后的跟踪性能，来评估控制器保留了哪些信息。我们使用一个模拟的力矩驱动的平面双连杆手臂，在速度相关的侧向力下向八个方向伸展。只有外部线性力矩读出器在线自适应；生成其特征的参数保持固定。特征来自三种闭式连续时间（CfC）网络配置、一个回声状态网络或一个径向基函数层。所有三种CfC配置，包括神经电路策略布线，均训练400个epoch。这五种基于特征的变体使用最小均方（LMS）学习；第六种在密集骨干CfC读出器上使用递归最小二乘（RLS）。学习率在三个模型初始化上选择，并在三个力场下的十个独立初始化上评估。所有六种变体相对于其固定读出基线均改善了跟踪性能，并在每次评估运行中通过了我们的后效应标准。在主力场中相同十个评估初始化（60种条件）上的诊断量化了这一共同决策背后的差异：在共同规定输入上，学习到的输出变化与理想补偿之间的中位数归一化平方残差在不同实现中范围为0.0097至0.383。在更新停止且反馈控制激活的情况下，所有最终读出器均保留了有用的补偿，相对于其预适应版本将跟踪误差降低了40-97%。与最终自适应周期相比，五种LMS变体的中位数固定读出误差比为2.28-5.87，而RLS几乎保持不变。这些测量区分了适应期间达到的性能与最终权重中保留的性能。它们为读出器适应提供了一种具体的评估程序：测量学习到的输出校正，并在更新关闭的情况下测试最终控制器，同时结合行为后效应。该比较表征了此任务中的完整实现；准备和超参数的差异限制了对特征表示或更新规则本身的归因。

papers.title: An expanded structural and biochemical map of GLI-SUFU recognition identifies binding-defective disease variants
papers.translated_title: GLI-SUFU识别的扩展结构与生化图谱鉴定出结合缺陷型疾病变异
papers.author: Bardwell, A. J.
papers.summary: The tumor suppressor SUFU is a key negative regulator of oncogenic GLI transcription factors. SUFU mutations predispose to medulloblastoma and can cause Gorlin and Joubert syndromes. Limited structural information is available on the GLI-SUFU complex, contributing to the fact that the vast majority of SUFU missense variants sequenced from affected patients are of unknown clinical significance. Using AlphaFold3 and complementary computational analysis, we predicted structures of the three human GLI-SUFU complexes and the orthologous Drosophila Ci-Sufu complex, revealing previously unrecognized contact interfaces. By site-directed mutagenesis and GLI-SUFU binding assays, we validated the importance of key interface residues, many of which are mutated in familial medulloblastoma and Gorlin syndrome. These findings provide new structure-function insights into a signaling complex mutated in cancer and rare congenital diseases, and offer an expanded framework for interpreting clinically observed SUFU variants and mechanisms that tune SUFU repression.
papers.translated_summary: 肿瘤抑制因子SUFU是致癌性GLI转录因子的关键负调控因子。SUFU突变易导致髓母细胞瘤，并可引发Gorlin综合征和Joubert综合征。关于GLI-SUFU复合物的结构信息有限，这导致从患者中测序得到的绝大多数SUFU错义变异具有未知的临床意义。我们利用AlphaFold3及互补的计算分析，预测了三种人类GLI-SUFU复合物及同源果蝇Ci-Sufu复合物的结构，揭示了此前未被识别的接触界面。通过定点诱变和GLI-SUFU结合实验，我们验证了关键界面残基的重要性，其中许多残基在家族性髓母细胞瘤和Gorlin综合征中发生突变。这些发现为一种在癌症和罕见先天性疾病中发生突变的信号复合物提供了新的结构与功能见解，并为解读临床观察到的SUFU变异及调控SUFU抑制作用的机制提供了扩展框架。

papers.title: Metabolic exploitation of the bacterial arginine deiminase pathway extends Caenorhabditis elegans healthspan
papers.translated_title: 细菌精氨酸脱亚胺酶途径的代谢利用延长秀丽隐杆线虫的健康寿命
papers.author: Ito, A.
papers.summary: While certain lactic acid bacteria extend Caenorhabditis elegans lifespan, the underlying mechanisms remain obscure. We investigated the lifespan-extending effects of Lactococcus lactis JCM 5805 (Lc5805). While live and heat-treated Lc5805 both extended mean lifespan, live Lc5805 uniquely prolonged maximum lifespan to 25 days, compared with 21 days for control and heat-treated groups. Ingesting live Lc5805 upregulated 74 cuticle-formation genes, predominantly collagen genes, supporting structural integrity without activating host stress responses. Metabolomic analyses revealed that live Lc5805 consumption induced L-citrulline and L-ornithine accumulation in C. elegans, which lacks a functional urea cycle. Intestinal expression of bacterial arginine deiminase (arcA), contrasted with the absence of citrulline accumulation in ADI-lacking bacteria and heat-treated groups, indicates that citrulline accumulation requires active bacterial enzymes to operate the arginine deiminase pathway in the gut. Through this 'metabolic exploitation', utilizing bacterial metabolites and enzymes for collagen maintenance, the host avoids endogenous energy expenditure.
papers.translated_summary: 虽然某些乳酸菌能延长秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们研究了乳酸乳球菌JCM 5805（Lc5805）的延寿效应。活菌和热处理后的Lc5805均能延长平均寿命，但活菌Lc5805独特地将最大寿命延长至25天，而对照组和热处理组为21天。摄入活菌Lc5805上调了74个角质层形成基因，主要是胶原蛋白基因，在不激活宿主应激反应的情况下支持结构完整性。代谢组学分析显示，摄入活菌Lc5805诱导了秀丽隐杆线虫体内L-瓜氨酸和L-鸟氨酸的积累，而该线虫缺乏功能性尿素循环。肠道中细菌精氨酸脱亚胺酶（arcA）的表达，与缺乏ADI的细菌及热处理组中无瓜氨酸积累形成对比，表明瓜氨酸积累需要活跃的细菌酶在肠道中运行精氨酸脱亚胺酶途径。通过这种“代谢利用”，即利用细菌代谢物和酶进行胶原蛋白维护，宿主避免了内源性能量消耗。

papers.title: Ancestral polyploidy and non-linear dosage shifts define the photosynthetic transition in the Heliantheae alliance
papers.translated_title: 祖先多倍化与非线性剂量变化共同定义了向日葵族联盟的光合作用转变
papers.author: Bonthala, V.
papers.summary: Whole-genome duplications (WGDs) have played a central role in plant evolutionary innovation, yet their genome-wide influence on complex physiological traits such as carbon-concentrating mechanisms (CCMs) remains poorly resolved. Here, we present high-quality genome assemblies and annotations for 35 species within the Heliantheae alliance (Asteraceae), spanning the complex photosynthetic spectrum from C3 to C4. Ks-based analyses combined with gene tree-species tree reconciliation identified a shared paleopolyploid event (WGD-2) ~30 million years ago. Using phylogenetically informed association mapping with these species, we detected 451 functional MapMan BINs with copy number variation significantly associated with interspecific variation in the CO2 compensation point. Notably, 303 of these BINs contain greater than 10% WGD-2-derived genes, indicating a strong enrichment of duplicated loci within photosynthetically relevant functional modules. Effect-size analysis revealed that the C3-to-C4 transition is governed by threshold-dependent genomic architecture rather than gradual additive change. Substantial expansions in key transcription factor modules, including HD-ZIP, HSF, LOB, and TCP, were associated with strong non-linear physiological shifts, consistent with genomic tipping points. By integrating comparative genomics, physiological trait variation, and evolutionary analysis, this study establishes a mechanistic link between ancient polyploidy and contemporary photosynthetic diversification. These findings provide a framework for understanding the genetic basis of carbon concentrating mechanism evolution and inform future optimization of photosynthetic efficiency in Asteraceae crops such as sunflower.
papers.translated_summary: 全基因组复制（WGD）在植物演化创新中发挥了核心作用，然而其对碳浓缩机制（CCMs）等复杂生理性状的全基因组影响仍鲜有解析。本文报道了菊科向日葵族联盟内35个物种的高质量基因组组装与注释，涵盖从C3到C4的复杂光合作用谱系。基于Ks的分析结合基因树-物种树 reconciliation 鉴定出约3000万年前一次共享的古多倍化事件（WGD-2）。利用系统发育信息关联作图，我们检测到451个MapMan BIN的功能拷贝数变异与CO2补偿点的种间变异显著相关。值得注意的是，其中303个BIN含有超过10%的WGD-2来源基因，表明重复位点在光合相关功能模块中强烈富集。效应量分析揭示C3向C4的转变受阈值依赖的基因组架构调控，而非渐进式加性变化。关键转录因子模块（包括HD-ZIP、HSF、LOB和TCP）的大幅扩张与强烈的非线性生理转变相关，符合基因组临界点特征。通过整合比较基因组学、生理性状变异和演化分析，本研究建立了古老多倍化与当代光合多样化之间的机制联系。这些发现为理解碳浓缩机制演化的遗传基础提供了框架，并为向日葵等菊科作物光合效率的未来优化提供了参考。

papers.title: Defining the Xanthomonas euvesicatoria type II-secreted effector arsenal reveals key roles in bacterial nutrition and diversity across species
papers.translated_title: 定义Xanthomonas euvesicatoria II型分泌效应蛋白库揭示其在细菌营养和跨物种多样性中的关键作用
papers.author: Goll, S.
papers.summary: The type II secretion (T2S) system is conserved across the Xanthomonas lineage, yet its contributions to pathogenicity and secreted protein repertoires are poorly defined. We demonstrate that T2S systems in Xanthomonas pathovars with divergent hosts and lifestyles are required for disease. Quantification of the plant cell wall composition during infection by Xanthomonas euvesicatoria (Xe) revealed a T2S-dependent depletion of galacturonic acid, suggesting T2 effector (T2E)-mediated cell wall remodeling. Using an in planta label-free proteomics approach, we identified two known and 20 new Xe T2Es from tomato apoplast, most annotated as cell wall-degrading enzymes and proteases. In vitro growth assays showed a T2S-mediated utilization of plant cell wall polysaccharides and proteins by Xe, as well as by Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines (Xag) and Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris (Xcc). Intriguingly, while families of cell wall-degrading enzymes are relatively well conserved across these three strains, protease repertoires have diversified significantly, suggesting more strain-specific functionalities. Our methodology establishes a framework for T2E discovery, enabling future functional dissection of this understudied effector class and its crosstalk with other bacterial virulence factors.
papers.translated_summary: II型分泌（T2S）系统在黄单胞菌谱系中保守存在，但其对致病性及分泌蛋白库的贡献尚不明确。我们证明，在宿主和生活方式存在差异的黄单胞菌致病变种中，T2S系统是致病所必需的。对辣椒斑点病菌（Xanthomonas euvesicatoria，Xe）侵染过程中植物细胞壁组成的定量分析揭示了半乳糖醛酸的T2S依赖性耗竭，提示T2效应蛋白（T2E）介导的细胞壁重塑。利用植物体内无标记蛋白质组学方法，我们从番茄质外体中鉴定出两个已知的和20个新的Xe T2E，其中大多数注释为细胞壁降解酶和蛋白酶。体外生长实验显示，Xe以及大豆致病变种Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines（Xag）和野油菜黄单胞菌致病变种Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris（Xcc）均表现出T2S介导的植物细胞壁多糖和蛋白质利用。有趣的是，尽管细胞壁降解酶家族在这三个菌株间相对保守，但蛋白酶库已显著多样化，提示存在更多菌株特异性功能。我们的方法建立了T2E发现的框架，为未来对这一研究不足的效应蛋白类别及其与其他细菌毒力因子间交互作用的功能解析奠定了基础。

papers.title: Heat-induced increases in xylem vulnerability: Experimental evidence and possible mechanisms
papers.translated_title: 木质部脆弱性的热诱导增加：实验证据与可能机制
papers.author: Link, R. M.
papers.summary: Hotter droughts driven by global warming are increasing tree mortality worldwide. Here, we propose a theoretical framework that explains how dissolved gas affects the stability of bubbles in xylem sap, and shows that in the presence of gas, sudden increases in temperature can accelerate embolism formation. We then provide experimental evidence that heat exposure can change xylem vulnerability to drought. Using data from seven Australian and European tree species, we assessed how elevated temperature (+15 and +20 {degrees}C above ambient) affects both xylem embolism resistance, measured with the Optical Vulnerability Technique, and VPD-corrected drying times. We found evidence for reduced embolism resistance and accelerated dehydration in heat-exposed plants. On average, trees reached the water potential at 50% loss of xylem function at 0.73 MPa less negative water potentials and 7.8 kPa h earlier, though responses were highly species-specific, and credibly different from zero only in the Australian species. Our results are consistent with the proposed framework and suggest that embolism resistance may not be a static trait, which has important repercussions for studies of plant vulnerability to drought. Further studies are necessary to assess the potential effects of heat-induced reductions in embolism resistance on tree mortality during heatwaves.
papers.translated_summary: 全球变暖驱动的更严重干旱正在增加全球范围内的树木死亡率。在此，我们提出一个理论框架，解释溶解气体如何影响木质部汁液中气泡的稳定性，并表明在存在气体的情况下，温度突然升高会加速栓塞形成。随后，我们提供实验证据，表明热暴露可以改变木质部对干旱的脆弱性。利用来自七种澳大利亚和欧洲树种的数据，我们评估了升高温度（高于环境温度+15和+20摄氏度）如何影响木质部栓塞抗性（用光学脆弱性技术测量）和经VPD校正的干燥时间。我们发现了热暴露植物中栓塞抗性降低和脱水加速的证据。平均而言，树木在木质部功能损失50%时的水势提前了0.73 MPa（水势较不负）和7.8 kPa h，尽管响应具有高度物种特异性，并且仅在澳大利亚树种中可信地不同于零。我们的结果与所提出的框架一致，并表明栓塞抗性可能不是一个静态性状，这对植物干旱脆弱性研究具有重要影响。需要进一步研究来评估热诱导的栓塞抗性降低对热浪期间树木死亡率的潜在影响。

papers.title: Genome-wide latitudinal variation associated with defence and reproductive pathways linked to Norway spruce adaptation
papers.translated_title: 全基因组纬度变异与防御和繁殖途径相关，这些途径与挪威云杉适应性有关
papers.author: Ranade, S. S.
papers.summary: Environmental cues modulate the natural variations in genes that outline local adaptation in plants for optimal survival. Genome-wide analysis using exome capture dataset in Norway spruce (Picea abies L. Kast) in Sweden revealed natural allelic variation in coding regions of genes associated with defence and reproductive pathways that follow a latitudinal cline, despite of the weak population structure with a low genetic differentiation. Steepest clines in the allele frequencies of missense SNPs from coding region (cSNPs) were detected in 60S RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN L18 (RPL18C), a gene involved in plant survival and defence/stress responses and LONG AFTER FAR-RED 3 (LAF3) that mediates light responses. This was closely followed by cline in ZINC 4 FINGER DNA 3'-PHOSPHOESTERASE (ZDP), involved in DNA repair and DNA demethylation pathways. Flowering genes that displayed latitudinal cline in cSNPs included BARELY ANY MERISTEM 1 (BAM1), REDUCED VERNALIZATION RESPONSE 1 (VRN1), FLOWERING CONTROL LOCUS A (FCA) and TERMINAL FLOWER 1 (TFL1) among few others. These variations may contribute to differential functioning of the defence/flowering genes, enabling the tree to thrive at its best under given local environmental conditions. The clines provide evidence towards local adaptation in these Norway spruce populations across Sweden; it coincides with the latitudinal variation in climatic conditions including temperature, day length and light quality, along with existing cline e.g. differential growth and defence response, and bud-burst/bud-set. The knowledge can be applied in forest industry to design future sustainable breeding strategies e.g. assisted migration, in the context of inevitable climate change.
papers.translated_summary: 环境线索调节基因的自然变异，这些基因勾勒出植物局部适应以实现最佳生存。利用瑞典挪威云杉（Picea abies L. Kast）外显子组捕获数据集进行的全基因组分析揭示，与防御和生殖途径相关基因编码区的自然等位变异遵循纬度梯度，尽管种群结构较弱且遗传分化较低。编码区错义SNP（cSNP）等位基因频率最陡峭的梯度出现在60S核糖体蛋白L18（RPL18C）中，该基因参与植物生存和防御/胁迫响应，以及介导光响应的LONG AFTER FAR-RED 3（LAF3）。紧随其后的是ZINC 4 FINGER DNA 3'-PHOSPHOESTERASE（ZDP）的梯度，该基因参与DNA修复和DNA去甲基化途径。cSNP显示纬度梯度的开花基因包括BARELY ANY MERISTEM 1（BAM1）、REDUCED VERNALIZATION RESPONSE 1（VRN1）、FLOWERING CONTROL LOCUS A（FCA）和TERMINAL FLOWER 1（TFL1）等少数几个。这些变异可能有助于防御/开花基因的差异功能，使树木能够在给定局部环境条件下以最佳状态生长。这些梯度为瑞典这些挪威云杉种群的局部适应提供了证据；它与气候条件（包括温度、日长和光质）的纬度变化相吻合，并与现有梯度如差异生长和防御响应以及芽萌发/芽形成相一致。这些知识可应用于林业，以在不可避免的气候变化背景下设计未来可持续育种策略，例如辅助迁移。

papers.title: Antagonism between sugar-dependent O-fucosylation and BIN2-mediated phosphorylation regulates metabolism and growth in Arabidopsis
papers.translated_title: 糖依赖性O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2介导的磷酸化之间的拮抗作用调控拟南芥的代谢与生长
papers.author: Zhang, H.
papers.summary: Coordinating sugar sensing, hormone signaling, and carbon metabolism is crucial for plant growth and environmental acclimation. Brassinosteroid (BR)-dependent phosphorylation and sugar-dependent O-glycosylation modify overlapping sets of proteins, but how these modifications co-regulate protein functions remains unknown. Here, we show that SPINDLY (SPY)-catalyzed O-fucosylation competes with BIN2-mediated phosphorylation and antagonistically regulates phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase 1 (PCK1), a key gluconeogenic enzyme. SPY associates with and O-fucosylates PCK1 within a peptide containing Ser-62 and Thr-66, two BIN2 phosphorylation sites that regulate PCK1 activity, preventing its phosphorylation by BIN2. PCK1 O-fucosylation and phosphorylation exclude each other and oppositely affect PCK1 activity in vivo. The spy mutants show increased PCK1 phosphorylation, reduced PCK activity, and impaired hypocotyl elongation; BR or BIN2 inhibitor treatments suppressed these phenotypes, indicating that these spy effects result from increased BIN2 phosphorylation. Together, these results reveal functional antagonism between SPY/O-fucosylation and BIN2/phosphorylation in regulating metabolism and growth
papers.translated_summary: 协调糖感知、激素信号传导和碳代谢对植物生长和环境适应至关重要。油菜素内酯（BR）依赖的磷酸化和糖依赖的O-糖基化修饰重叠的蛋白质集合，但这些修饰如何共同调控蛋白质功能仍不清楚。在此，我们表明SPINDLY（SPY）催化的O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2介导的磷酸化竞争，并拮抗性调控磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶1（PCK1），一种关键的糖异生酶。SPY与PCK1结合并在包含Ser-62和Thr-66的肽段内对其进行O-岩藻糖基化，这两个BIN2磷酸化位点调控PCK1活性，从而阻止BIN2对其磷酸化。PCK1的O-岩藻糖基化和磷酸化相互排斥，并在体内对PCK1活性产生相反影响。spy突变体显示PCK1磷酸化增加、PCK活性降低和下胚轴伸长受损；BR或BIN2抑制剂处理抑制了这些表型，表明这些spy效应源于BIN2磷酸化增加。总之，这些结果揭示了SPY/O-岩藻糖基化与BIN2/磷酸化在调控代谢和生长中的功能性拮抗。

papers.title: Photoswitchable optoGPCRs for reversible control of Gs signalling and arrestin recruitment
papers.translated_title: 用于可逆控制Gs信号传导和抑制蛋白招募的光开关光遗传学GPCR
papers.author: Walter, D.
papers.summary: OptoGPCRs are light-activatable G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) used to optogenetically control physiological processes. Most existing optoGPCRs are based on monostable opsins, which are limited by photobleaching and irreversibility. The bistable jumping spider rhodopsin 1 (JSR1) carrying the single point mutant S199F introduces a ~150 nm spectral separation between the active and inactive states, enabling bidirectional control with distinct wavelengths of light. Here, we show that JSR1-S199F robustly and reversibly recruits arrestin and modulates Gq/i protein activity. We then engineered JSR1-S199F-based optoGPCRs with Gs protein activity, guided by AlphaFold-predicted receptor-miniGs complexes, to expand the limited repertoire of bistable Gs-coupled optoGPCRs. Specifically, we present optoDRD1, a chimeric optoGPCR that redirects the native Gq/i protein activity of JSR1 towards the Gs pathway of the dopamine D1 receptor (DRD1). Through systematic screening of intracellular domain combinations, we identified a chimeric configuration with the highest absolute cAMP output comprising ICL2, ICL3, helix 8, and the C-terminus from DRD1. The resulting optoGPCR is activated by violet light ({lambda}max = 397 nm) and deactivated by green light ({lambda}max = 531 nm) at physiologically relevant light intensities. A single violet light pulse drives sustained Gs signalling for several hours, while green light rapidly deactivates the receptor at any chosen time point, enabling repeatable switching between active and inactive states over multiple cycles. OptoDRD1 closely mimics wild-type DRD1 in both cAMP signalling kinetics and G protein selectivity, with a signal amplitude comparable to native Gs-coupled receptors, including JellyOp. We further demonstrate optoDRD1's utility for optogenetic control of Gs-regulated processes in vitro, including insulin secretion in human {beta}-cells and signalling modulation in a neuronal cell line. The biochemical stability and known structure of JSR1 make it a robust scaffold for this rational engineering and for future biophysical characterization. Together, optoDRD1 and JSR1-S199F expand the optoGPCR toolkit and open new opportunities for dissecting dopaminergic signalling, Gs-mediated physiology, and GPCR signalling pharmacology.
papers.translated_summary: 光遗传学G蛋白偶联受体（OptoGPCRs）是一类光可激活的G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs），用于光遗传学控制生理过程。现有大多数光遗传学GPCRs基于单稳态视蛋白，受限于光漂白和不可逆性。携带单点突变S199F的双稳态跳蛛视紫红质1（JSR1）在活性态与非活性态之间引入约150 nm的光谱间隔，从而能够以不同波长的光实现双向控制。在此，我们证明JSR1-S199F能够稳健且可逆地招募arrestin并调节Gq/i蛋白活性。随后，我们以AlphaFold预测的受体-miniGs复合物为指导，工程化改造了具有Gs蛋白活性的JSR1-S199F基光遗传学GPCRs，以扩展有限的双稳态Gs偶联光遗传学GPCRs库。具体而言，我们提出了optoDRD1，一种嵌合光遗传学GPCR，将JSR1天然的Gq/i蛋白活性重定向至多巴胺D1受体（DRD1）的Gs通路。通过对细胞内结构域组合的系统筛选，我们鉴定出一种具有最高绝对cAMP输出的嵌合构型，其包含来自DRD1的ICL2、ICL3、螺旋8和C末端。所得光遗传学GPCR在生理相关光强度下由紫光（λmax = 397 nm）激活、由绿光（λmax = 531 nm）失活。单次紫光脉冲可驱动持续的Gs信号传导数小时，而绿光可在任意选定时间点迅速使受体失活，从而在多个循环中实现活性态与非活性态之间的可重复切换。OptoDRD1在cAMP信号动力学和G蛋白选择性方面均紧密模拟野生型DRD1，其信号幅度与天然Gs偶联受体（包括JellyOp）相当。我们进一步证明了optoDRD1在体外光遗传学控制Gs调控过程中的实用性，包括人β细胞中的胰岛素分泌以及神经元细胞系中的信号调节。JSR1的生化稳定性和已知结构使其成为这一理性工程改造及未来生物物理表征的稳健支架。总之，optoDRD1和JSR1-S199F扩展了光遗传学GPCR工具包，并为剖析多巴胺能信号传导、Gs介导的生理过程以及GPCR信号药理学开辟了新机遇。

papers.title: Auditory cortex deviance detection represents a canonical difference signal
papers.translated_title: 听觉皮层的偏差检测代表了一种典型的差异信号
papers.author: Hockley, A.
papers.summary: Context modulates neural processing of sensory stimuli. Excitatory neuron responses are most often suppressed to stimuli that are typical of the current context and augmented to stimuli that are deviant. These effects have been extensively studied in basic and clinical neuroscience using oddball paradigms, involving the repeating of standard stimuli and the insertion of rare deviant stimuli. Augmented neural responses to deviants - referred to as deviance detection - have been interpreted within predictive coding frameworks as prediction errors, signaling the difference between internal predictions and actual sensory input. However, most oddball paradigms simultaneously alter both predictions and input, so cannot test for a true difference signal. As yet, no studies have demonstrated that neural deviance detection during oddball paradigms specifically encodes the difference between internal predictions and unexpected sensory input, as opposed to, e.g., a generalised surprise signal or augmented bottom-up signaling. Here we compare neural responses to auditory stimuli across oddball paradigm variants.In a classical oddball paradigm, responses of putative excitatory neurons in the primary auditory cortex (A1) to auditory deviants contain information about recent frequency change and retain a memory trace of previous stimulus context. Interestingly, in a fixed-deviant oddball paradigm where the standards (theoretical predictions) were altered between blocks, but deviant stimulus features remain unchanged, neural response patterns encoded standard-to-deviant frequency difference. Together, these findings support the interpretation that A1 deviance detection contains a sensory prediction error that represents the difference between prediction and sensory input, a corollary of the predictive coding framework.
papers.translated_summary: 情境调节感觉刺激的神经处理。兴奋性神经元的反应通常对符合当前情境特征的刺激受到抑制，而对偏离刺激则增强。这些效应已在基础与临床神经科学中通过oddball范式得到广泛研究，该范式涉及重复标准刺激并插入罕见偏离刺激。对偏离刺激增强的神经反应——被称为偏离检测——在预测编码框架下被解释为预测误差，标志着内部预测与实际感觉输入之间的差异。然而，大多数oddball范式同时改变预测和输入，因此无法检验真正的差异信号。迄今为止，尚无研究表明oddball范式中的神经偏离检测专门编码内部预测与意外感觉输入之间的差异，而非例如一般化的惊讶信号或增强的自下而上信号传递。在此，我们比较了不同oddball范式变体中对听觉刺激的神经反应。在经典oddball范式中，初级听觉皮层（A1）中推测的兴奋性神经元对听觉偏离刺激的反应包含关于近期频率变化的信息，并保留先前刺激情境的记忆痕迹。有趣的是，在固定偏离oddball范式中，当标准刺激（理论预测）在不同组块间改变，但偏离刺激特征保持不变时，神经反应模式编码了标准到偏离的频率差异。总之，这些发现支持这样的解释：A1偏离检测包含一个感觉预测误差，表征预测与感觉输入之间的差异，这是预测编码框架的一个推论。
